label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_04_01
text: Right! Let’s see—if I had to recommend a next\ndestination for you...

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_20a
text: I’d guess a fresh-faced student belongs in school!\c\nHead to Naranja Academy, why don’t you?\nYou must be excited to join your class!

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_20b
text: I’d guess a fresh-faced student belongs in school!\c\nHead to Uva Academy, why don’t you? You must\nbe excited to join your class!

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_21a
text:
I’d guess there are still corners of the academy
you haven’t checked out.\c
Don’t be afraid to visit different rooms—
who knows who you’ll end up meeting!

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_21b
text:
I’d guess there are still corners of the academy
you haven’t checked out.\c
Don’t be afraid to go into different rooms—
who knows who you’ll end up meeting!

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_00
text: ...Nope! Sorry, I’ve got nothing!\c\nYou’re ready for anything Paldea could possibly\nthrow at you, so I’d say go wherever you’d like!

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_01
text: You should pay a visit to the Cortondo Gym!\c\nHave you considered trying to take on Gym\nLeader Katy in charming Cortondo?

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_02
text: I’d recommend the Artazon Gym!\c\nHave you thought about taking on Gym Leader\nBrassius? He’s in picturesque Artazon!

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_03
text: Well, how about the Cascarrafa Gym?\c\nYou could try taking on Gym Leader Kofu in\nrefreshing Cascarrafa!

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_04
text: I’d aim for the Levincia Gym!\c\nYou could try challenging Gym Leader Iono in\nthe dazzling city of Levincia!

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_05
text: I think you’d better visit the Medali Gym!\c\nYou could try taking on Gym Leader Larry next.\nYou’ll find him in good old Medali.

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_06
text: I’d say it’s time for the Glaseado Gym.\c\nWhat do you think of challenging Gym Leader\nGrusha up on Glaseado Mountain?

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_07
text: I think you should try the Montenevera Gym next.\c\nYou could try challenging Gym Leader Ryme\nin chilly Montenevera!

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_08
text: I’d say, how about the Alfornada Gym?\c\nHave you considered taking on Gym Leader Tulip\nin scorching Alfornada?

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_09
text: I’d say make for the lair of the Rock-type Titan!\c\nWhy not try to seek out the Pokémon known as\nthe Stony Cliff Titan?

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_10
text: I’d say make for the lair of the Steel-type Titan!\c\nMaybe try seeking out the Pokémon known as\nthe Lurking Steel Titan?

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_11
text: I’d say make for the lair of the Flying-type Titan!\c\nThink you might be up to seeking out the\nso-called Open Sky Titan?

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_12
text: I’d say make for the lair of the Ground-type Titan!\c\nDo you dare seek out the Pokémon that has been\ncalled the Quaking Earth Titan?

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_13
text: I’d say make for the lair of the Dragon-type Titan!\c\nWhy not seek out the Pokémon called the\nFalse Dragon Titan?

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_14
text: It’d be the base of Team Star’s Fairy crew!\c\nOrtega, the boss of the Ruchbah Squad, would\nprobably welcome a challenge, from what I hear.

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_15
text: It’d be the base of Team Star’s Dark crew!\c\nI hear Giacomo, the boss of the Segin Squad,\nis just waiting for someone to battle.

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_16
text: It’d be the base of Team Star’s Fire crew!\c\nSeems like Mela, the boss of the Schedar Squad,\nis burning for someone to battle against.

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_17
text: It’d be the base of Team Star’s Poison crew!\c\nAtticus, the boss of the Navi Squad, is apparently\nwaiting for someone to battle.

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_18
text: It’d be the base of Team Star’s Fighting crew!\c\nI’m pretty sure Eri, the boss of the Caph Squad,\ncould use a good challenge in battle.

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_hint_19
text: Go to Area Zero in the Great Crater of Paldea!\c\nI think you’ve got some tried-and-true friends\nwaiting for you there.

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_04_02
text: I’ll go ahead and mark the spot in your map app\nfor you.

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_04_03
text: You’ve got a destination set in your map app\nalready. Is it OK if I replace it with this one?

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_04_04
text: All right...you’re all set! Go out there and have\nan adventure—we’ll be here when you need us!

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_04_05
text: All righty—I’ll leave your map be! Have fun\nexploring, and we’ll be here when you need us!

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_03_02
text:
Feliz cumpleaños! Congratulations on your
birthday!\c
I do hope you keep visiting the Pokémon Center
for many years to come!\c
Now, are you here to let your Pokémon rest?

label: msg_pokecen_birthday_02

label: msg_pokecen_birthday_03
text: Oh, today is a special day, isn’t it?\c\nI know it’s actually a day early, but we wish you\na very happy birthday!

text:
Be sure to visit a Pokémon Center whenever your
Pokémon [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0302)]isare running low on HP.\c

label: msg_common_mama_01
text: Study hard and play hard, that’s what I say!\nYou should enjoy your days as a student.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

text:

[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c
Your Pokémon [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0302)]isare looking a bit weary, though.
Why don’t you have a nice rest together?\c

label: msg_common_gameover_mama_02
text:
There you are! A nice long nap is all a body
needs to feel ready for more adventure, right?\c
Doesn’t matter whether you’re a person or a
Pokémon—we all need to take time to rest.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Certainly! Allow me to get your birthday\nregistered in our system,\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!

label: msg_pokecen_set_birth_04

label: msg_pokecen_set_birth_05
text: You should stop by on your big day, too!\nWe’ll be expecting you on [VAR 0x0201(0001)]/[VAR 0x0201(0002)]!

label: msg_pokecen_set_birth_06
text: Oh, and if your very special birthday isn’t on the\ncalendar this year, then please come on 2/28!

label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_00
text: Oh! By the way—did you know...?

label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_01
text: Or did you already know that? Well, I do hope\nmy little tidbits come in handy!

text:
With all the little tidbits that I’ve shared with you
so far, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...\c
you should now know just about everything you
need as you go adventuring!\c
Flip back through your Adventure Guide from
time to time, though, as you enjoy exploring!

text: Hey there. This is the Pokémon Center. Are your\nPokémon tired and needing a rest?

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_01_03_s1
text: Still up and about? Well, this is your Pokémon\nCenter. Wanna rest your tired Pokémon?

label: msg_common_gameover_pc_01_s1
text: First, let’s restore your Pokémon to full health.

label: msg_common_gameover_pc_02_01_s1
text:
You know, you’d better visit a Pokémon Center
whenever your Pokémon [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0302)]isare running low on HP.\c
And you should stock up on, like, lotsa Potions
and stuff at Peachy’s or wherever.

label: msg_common_gameover_pc_02_02_s1
text:
Anyway, I healed up your Pokémon—all happy
and healthy again.\c
I’m glad they’re all OK. Be more careful out
there, would ya?

label: msg_pokecen_freetalk_01_01_s1
text:
Whoa. Gimme some room to breathe here,
would ya?\c
If you want me to heal your Pokémon, I’m gonna
need you over on the other side of the counter.

label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_00_s1
text: Y’know...I keep seeing you around here,\nso I thought I’d ask...

label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_01_s1
text: Has anyone taught you the new pose that\neverybody’s using in their selfies nowadays?\r\nIt’s like a double peace sign but with a twist.

label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_02_s1
text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Upside-Down Peace emote [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]from\nthe Pokémon Center lady!

label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_03_s1
text: Maybe give it a try sometime, if you feel like it.

label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_04_s1
text: Y’know...you sure do visit me a whole lot. I’d\nsay you’ve probably earned another sweet tip.

label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_05_s1
text: So when you’re taking a selfie, right? Try holding\na Poké Ball up all close to your face.\c\nIt’ll make you look super cute. You should try it.

label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_06_s1
text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Poké Ball emote [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]from the\nPokémon Center lady!

label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_07_s1
text: If you’re feeling like you need just a touch more\ncute in a shot, you should give it a try.

label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_04
text: Oh, and that’s right—I have a new tip to share\nwith you!

label: msg_pokecen_tips_introduction_05
text:
With all the little tidbits that I’ve shared with you
till now, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...\c
you probably know just about everything you
ought to know about adventuring, for real!\c
Flip back through your Adventure Guide from
time to time, though, as you enjoy exploring!

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_self_05
text: Oh no! Are you OK?! We’d better get your\nPokémon healed up at once!

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_self_06
text:
You should be a bit more diligent in healing up
your Pokémon when they’re getting weak.\c
It helps if you load up on Potions from the
vending machine!

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_self_07
text: Looks like your Pokémon [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0302)]isare all healed now.\nTime to get back to adventuring!

label: msg_pokecen_kaifuku_self_08
text: If you use the machine next to me here, you can\nget your Pokémon healed in a jiffy.
